stories.headline: Stocks post worst run since 2023 as AI trade cracks
stories.summary: US equities are on their worst losing streak since 2023 as cracks widen in the AI trade, with mega-cap tech leading declines despite Anthropic's blockbuster debut. Investors are rotating out of high-multiple AI names amid concerns about valuations and spending sustainability.

stories.headline: Anthropic shares dive after blockbuster IPO debut
stories.summary: Anthropic's stock fell sharply the day after its IPO, which had valued the AI company near $1.5 trillion, as broader tech weakness and profit-taking weighed on the newly listed shares. The reversal underscores how quickly sentiment can turn on richly valued AI names.

stories.headline: China's AI firms face Nvidia chip supply crunch as access tightens
stories.summary: Chinese AI companies that built their infrastructure around Nvidia chips are now struggling with restricted supply, forcing a scramble for alternatives. The report highlights how export controls continue to reshape the competitive landscape for AI compute in China.

stories.headline: California opens probe into Nvidia over China AI chip sales
stories.summary: California regulators have launched an inquiry targeting Nvidia related to its AI chip sales involving China, adding a new regulatory risk for the chipmaker. The probe comes amid heightened scrutiny of semiconductor export practices.

stories.headline: Third-party data breach exposes JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard customer data
stories.summary: A breach at a third-party vendor exposed customer data tied to JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard, raising fresh concerns about supply-chain cybersecurity risk in financial services. The scope of affected customers and remediation steps were still being assessed.

stories.headline: UnitedHealth shares continue to slide amid Medicare for All push
stories.summary: UnitedHealth stock extended its decline as political momentum builds behind Medicare for All proposals, which investors see as a structural threat to private insurers' business models. The selloff reflects growing policy risk pricing into managed-care names.

stories.headline: Walmart's digital sales now driving growth more than stores
stories.summary: Walmart's e-commerce business has become the primary growth engine for the retail giant, overtaking physical store sales growth, according to a new report. The shift reflects continued investment in digital fulfillment and marketplace expansion.

stories.headline: Nvidia trades roughly 30% below fair value, says valuation expert
stories.summary: NYU professor Aswath Damodaran, known as the 'Dean of Valuation,' said Nvidia shares are trading about 30% below his estimate of fair value and that he is waiting for a price near $140 to add to his position. The comment comes as Nvidia shares have been under pressure amid broader AI-trade jitters.
